div.div:
Object storage metadata; DB transaction does not pretend to atomically commit remote
bytes.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
uploaded_by_user_id: uuid [FK ?]
object_key: text [UQ NN]
purpose: text [NN]
mime_type: text [NN]
size_bytes: bigint [NN]
sha256: text [NN]
status: text [NN]
default 'pending'
scanned_at: timestamptz [?]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (object_key)
CK1: purpose IN ('event_image','ticket_pdf','support_attachment','offline_package')
CK2: status IN ('pending','quarantined','clean','rejected','deleted')
CK3: size_bytes >= 0
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(uploaded_by_user_id) -> app_user(id) [0..1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
One contextual thread, resolved through current relationships and explicit escalation.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
requester_user_id: uuid [FK NN]
organization_id: uuid [FK ?]
event_id: uuid [FK ?]
order_id: uuid [FK ?]
ticket_id: uuid [FK ?]
case_kind: text [NN]
category: text [NN]
subject: text [NN]
status: text [NN]
default 'open'
assigned_to_user_id: uuid [FK ?]
escalated_at: timestamptz [?]
resolved_at: timestamptz [?]
updated_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
CK1: case_kind IN ('attendee','organizer_platform')
CK2: category IN
('delivery','payment','refund','seating','event_info','check_in','account','technical')
CK3: status IN ('open','in_progress','waiting_customer','resolved')
CK4: (status = 'resolved') = (resolved_at IS NOT NULL)
CK5: order_id IS NULL OR event_id IS NOT NULL
CK6: ticket_id IS NULL OR event_id IS NOT NULL
CK7: event_id IS NULL OR organization_id IS NOT NULL
CK8: case_kind <> 'attendee' OR (event_id IS NOT NULL AND organization_id IS NOT NULL)
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(event_id, organization_id) -> event(id, organization_id) [0..1 parent / 0..* children]
(order_id, event_id) -> ticket_order(id, event_id) [0..1 parent / 0..* children]
(ticket_id, event_id) -> ticket(id, event_id) [0..1 parent / 0..* children]
(requester_user_id) -> app_user(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
(assigned_to_user_id) -> app_user(id) [0..1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Append-only persisted message; delivery/reconnect does not duplicate it.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
case_id: uuid [FK NN]
author_user_id: uuid [FK NN]
client_message_id: uuid [NN]
body: text [NN]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (case_id, author_user_id, client_message_id)
UQ2: (id, case_id)
CK1: length(btrim(body)) > 0
TRIGGER: reject UPDATE / DELETE (append-only).
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(case_id) -> support_case(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
(author_user_id) -> app_user(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Protected attachment belongs to an actual persisted message and its case.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
case_id: uuid [FK NN]
message_id: uuid [FK NN]
file_id: uuid [FK UQ NN]
original_filename: text [NN]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (file_id)
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(message_id, case_id) -> support_message(id, case_id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
(file_id) -> stored_file(id) [1 parent / 0..1 children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Append-only status, assignment, escalation and reopening history.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
case_id: uuid [FK NN]
actor_user_id: uuid [FK NN]
change_kind: text [NN]
before_value: text [?]
after_value: text [?]
reason: text [?]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
CK1: change_kind IN ('status','assignment','escalation')
TRIGGER: reject UPDATE / DELETE (append-only).
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(case_id) -> support_case(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
(actor_user_id) -> app_user(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.
